name: Kumaraguru College of Technology (KCT)
summary: Kumaraguru College of Technology, Coimbatore, started in 1984 and is an autonomous, self-financing engineering college affiliated to Anna University and accredited by NAAC. It reports 15 undergraduate programmes; Edugate lists the 14 B.E./B.Tech programmes it could verify.
